content.text: {"abstained":false,"abstention_reason":"","answer":"Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY) is the accident-insurance programme abbreviated as PMSBY [E01]. The scheme covers accidental death and disability [E01]. Specifically, it triggers cover for: death on account of an accident (nominee receives Rs. 2 Lakhs) [E01]; total and irrecoverable loss of both eyes, loss of use of both hands or feet, or loss of sight of one eye and loss of use of hand or foot (subscriber receives Rs. 2 Lakhs) [E01]; and total and irrecoverable loss of sight of one eye or loss of use of one hand or foot (subscriber receives Rs. 1 Lakh) [E01].","cited_evidence_ids":["E01"],"claim_to_evidence":[{"claim":"PMSBY stands for Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana","evidence_ids":["E01"]},{"claim":"PMSBY is an accident insurance scheme offering accidental death and disability cover","evidence_ids":["E01"]},{"claim":"On death, the nominee receives Rs. 2 Lakhs","evidence_ids":["E01"]},{"claim":"For total and irrecoverable loss of both eyes, both hands/feet, or one eye and one hand/foot, subscriber receives Rs. 2 Lakhs","evidence_ids":["E01"]},{"claim":"For total and irrecoverable loss of one eye or one hand/foot, subscriber receives Rs. 1 Lakh","evidence_ids":["E01"]}]}
